content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to set up communication between [product_name] and [product_name] PLCs, but it's not working even though I followed the example manual. Are there any additional settings I should be aware of? Is there another manual I can use?

Are you using [product_name] [article_no]? The IP addresses for each device must be different but within the same range (198.168.0.xxx). Each device needs a unique value for 'xxx,' which should not exceed a certain limit (not sure of the exact value). The subnet mask should be the same (255.255.255.0). I couldn't find this setting for the PLC in the manual (possibly page 3?). Is a PC also connected in your network? The PC's IP should also be unique and not clash with the others. Can you access PC to [product_name]? Can you access PC to PLC?
